preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have accumulated token balance from fees to trigger swapAndLiquify

exploit_hint: As owner, set _percentageOfLiquidityForMarketing to >100 (e.g., 200) and ensure contract has token balance. When swapAndLiquify triggers, marketingFee calculation will overflow, causing all BNB from token swap to be sent to marketing/investing wallets (which owner controls). Alternatively, set maxWalletToken to 0 to block all user transfers while owner remains unaffected.
